newsitem.title: USA: CIBC, Oppenheimer silent on report of talks.
newsitem.headline: CIBC, Oppenheimer silent on report of talks.

text.p: CIBC Wood Gundy has been in talks about an acquisition of Oppenheimer & Co, the Wall Street Journal reported Friday.
Spokeswomen for both companies declined comment.
CIBC Wood Gundy is a unit of Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce.

Separately, American Banker quoted Charles Gifford, chief executive of BankBoston Corp as saying his company looked at Oppenheimer but decided it would not be a good fit. A BankBoston spokesman was not available for comment.
A source familiar with the situation said PNC Bank Corp had broken off talks to acquire Oppenheimer. PNC Bank declined comment.
